HELP_MONSTERCARDS_7: A lot of monsters, but not all, come with their own specialised skill beyond a basic attack. If they have one, it will be described on the card.\n\nDuring combat you may select these additional abilities instead of performing a basic attack, provided you have the Mojo to pay for it.
HELP_AFF_1:
"Affliction" is a catch-all term for any lasting effects an attack might leave on a creature. They will either last one round or forever, and fall into one of two categories - good and bad.

Some spells and abilities might act to remove a particular affliction, whilst others might act on good or bad ones collectively.

Remember that any creature stepping on to a regen tile will have all bad afflictions cured instantly.
HELP_AFF_3: A creature afflicted with @C[1]Mighty@C[0] gains a AF_Mighty_Power boost. This effect is permanent for as long as the affliction remains.
HELP_AFF_4: @C[1]Berserk@C[0] can be a game changer, usually self inflicted as an activated ability. A creature with @C[1]Berserk@C[0] gains a AF_Berserk_Power boost but all incoming attacks on it get AF_Berserk_AttackerPower. This effect is permanent for as long as the affliction remains.
HELP_AFF_5: A creature that has @C[1]Ice Block@C[0] is not targetable by attacks or other abilities, and the creature trapped within takes no damage. This effect wears off after its owners' next-but-one upkeep.
HELP_AFF_6: A @C[1]Magic Shield@C[0] is usually generated by a neaby monster's activated ability. The shield will completely absorb the next incoming attack, which then causes it to dissipate.
HELP_AFF_7: A creature afflicted with @C[1]Vengeance@C[0] will see a dagger above its head. When this creature next attacks, the dagger will fall causing it AF_Vengeance_Health.
HELP_AFF_8: A creature afflicted with @C[1]Flame@C[0] will suffer AF_Flame_Health during each of its owner's upkeep phases. This effect is permanent for as long as the affliction remains.
HELP_AFF_9: A creature afflicted with @C[1]Death Mark@C[0] will see a red skull above its head. Whenever this creature is attacked, it will suffer an additional AF_DeathMark_AttackerPower damage.
HELP_AFF_10: A creature afflicted with @C[1]Dazed@C[0] cannot attack until the affliction wears off. This effect wears off after its owners' next-but-one upkeep.
HELP_AFF_11: A creature afflicted with @C[1]Snared@C[0] cannot move until the affliction wears off. This effect wears off after its owners' next-but-one upkeep.
HELP_AFF_12: @C[1]Dazed@C[0], @C[1]Snared@C[0] and @C[1]Ice Block@C[0] all wear off at their owner's next-but-one upkeep phase, no matter what. This means that once a creature has one of these afflictions, there is nothing to gain by trying to afflict it again with the same thing.
HELP_AFF_14: A creature afflicted with @C[1]Stunted@C[0] cannot use its activated ability.
